how_to_fill: Every 'at' and 'via' is 'lat, lon'. In Google Maps: right-click the spot, click the numbers to copy.
The first route is the usual one. 'via' is one or more points ON the road that route uses, in walking order.
'road' is main or local. 'name' is the road name a parent would recognise. 'name_hi' is optional.
The air station for Asansol is at 23.685297, 86.945968 (Asansol Court Area, Asansol). Pick a school within a few km of it: the forecast is for the air there.
